I have the answer from the documents.

## Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby

A reflow oven in standby still draws **36% of its 70 kW rating = 25.2 kW** for as long as it is left running [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby]. That is a large, continuous load producing nothing, so it is the single largest source of weekend idle energy [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Purpose]. A properly switched-off oven uses only about 340–350 kWh per oven-weekend (residual heat loss), versus the full 25.2 kW while in standby [source: docs/knowledge/equipment/EQ-01_reflow_oven.md#EQ-01 Reflow Oven Manual > Energy-saving notes].

## Excess energy in incident S5

During incident S5 (2025-10-17 to 2025-10-20), RF-02 was left in standby all weekend. Weekend energy was about **1,556 kWh** versus about **346 kWh** normal, an excess of about **1,210 kWh** from that single oven [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Why reflow ovens must be OFF, not standby].

## Load Shedding Order (SOP-03 / EM-02 playbook)

**Shed first:** **EV charging (EV-01)** — paused first, at Order 1 of the playbook, because it has no effect on production. [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-02_demand_management.md#EM-02 Demand Management > Load-shed playbook]

The full shed order is:
1. Pause EV charging (EV-01) — 100% [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-02_demand_management.md#EM-02 Demand Management > Load-shed playbook]
2. Delay the next burn-in loading (BI-01, BI-02) — 35% [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-02_demand_management.md#EM-02 Demand Management > Load-shed playbook]
3. Raise chilled-water setpoint +1 °C (CH-01, CH-02) — 4% [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-02_demand_management.md#EM-02 Demand Management > Load-shed playbook]
4. Lower compressed-air pressure 0.5 bar (AC-01, AC-02, AC-03) — 3.5% [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-02_demand_management.md#EM-02 Demand Management > Load-shed playbook]

**Loads that must never be shed:**
- Server room (DC-01) [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-02_demand_management.md#EM-02 Demand Management > Load-shed playbook > Never shed]
- Running molders mid-cycle (IM-01 to IM-04) [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-02_demand_management.md#EM-02 Demand Management > Load-shed playbook > Never shed]
- Reflow ovens with boards inside (RF-01 to RF-03) [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-02_demand_management.md#EM-02 Demand Management > Load-shed playbook > Never shed]

This is confirmed by the energy policy: "The server room, running molders mid-cycle and reflow ovens with boards inside are never shed." [source: docs/knowledge/energy-management/EM-01_energy_policy.md#EM-01 Energy Policy > Operating principles]
